prompt:

Reference 1 is the exact Sobaya character identity sheet. Reference 2 is the established damaged shrine/location. Reference 3 is his later fully illuminated reveal; preserve this same identity, not its lighting or seated composition.
The camera is the cursed narrator's unrecorded subjective view, standing beside the broken small wooden shrine and looking into the woods behind it. Sobaya stands completely still roughly 4 meters away, turned frontally toward the viewer, in deep tree shadow. Natural adult proportions: 180 cm, very heavy broad-shouldered muscular build, short black hair. His canonical white mask stays fully on: two large round black eye holes, narrow horizontal black mouth opening, black circular forehead mark, long red vertical markings above and below the eyes exactly as in the references. All exposed skin including neck, ears, arms and hands is neutral ash gray, not human pink.
He wears an opaque plain white T-shirt and dark trousers. Smooth opaque cloth over the chest with ordinary fabric folds and muscle volume; absolutely no nipple protrusions, nipple outlines or point-like shadows. Hands hang naturally at his sides, no beer or mug yet. Nobody else in the image.
VERY LOW KEY MOONLIGHT: most of the body and setting disappear into near-black shadow. A narrow soft patch of moonlight catches about half of the mask, the edge of one broad shoulder, and one exposed gray forearm. The mask's round eye holes and some muted red markings and the visibly gray forearm must be just legible to a viewer at 720p. Do not make him a featureless black silhouette, do not brightly illuminate his whole face or torso, and do not use artificial rim lighting, glowing eyes, theatrical fog, blue fantasy effects, or a dramatic horror poster look. He seems quietly present before the eye notices him.
Frame medium-wide with Sobaya centered slightly left, head at x45% y25%, visible head-to-upper-thigh above the bottom subtitle area, occupying about 55% frame height. A dark portion of the collapsed shrine and tree trunk frame the right foreground; old wooden buildings and wet leaves barely visible in the darkness. Keep the bottom 23% mostly dark for subtitles. Subtle film grain and restrained natural moonlight. One finished image only, no collage, no labels.
review: Mask markings, adult muscular proportions and gray skin match references. White opaque T-shirt has no nipple outlines. Low moonlight reveals mask and forearm without the later ritual's full illumination.
